description: This PHP source file defines the 'ImageController' class within a Corporate Branding plugin for OrangeHRM. It handles requests to serve various branding images such as client logos and banners, utilizing theme services for image retrieval and cache validation.

classes.name: ImageController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling image requests related to corporate branding, such as client logos and banners, with cache validation.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes incoming requests to retrieve and serve the specified branding image, including cache validation through ETag headers.

methods.name: setCommonHeaders
methods.description: Sets common HTTP headers for cache control and content type on the response.
